description: Updates broker credential metadata and optionally replaces Vault material for the authenticated owner. This replaces the saved credential values when credentialValues is provided; it never returns raw values. Use this for broker login/trading credentials only. Do not add a brokerCredentialId to a deployment by default; let the user choose on the approval page unless they explicitly named the exact saved broker connection/account. The broker field controls validation for known Lumibot/BotSpot brokers; use the exact environment variable key names below. Kalshi (kalshi): KALSHI_API_KEY_ID + KALSHI_PRIVATE_KEY. Optional: KALSHI_SUBACCOUNT, KALSHI_EXCHANGE_INDEX, KALSHI_BASE_URL, KALSHI_WS_URL. Do not pass KALSHI_IS_DEMO; BotSpot derives it from paperOrLive. Example credentialValues: {"KALSHI_API_KEY_ID":"key-id...","KALSHI_PRIVATE_KEY":"private-key-pem..."}. Alpaca (alpaca): ALPACA_API_KEY + ALPACA_API_SECRET OR ALPACA_OAUTH_TOKEN. Do not pass ALPACA_IS_PAPER; BotSpot derives it from paperOrLive. Example credentialValues: {"ALPACA_API_KEY":"PK...","ALPACA_API_SECRET":"secret..."}. Tradier (tradier): TRADIER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER + TRADIER_ACCESS_TOKEN OR TRADIER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER + TRADIER_API_KEY OR TRADIER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER + TRADIER_TOKEN. Optional: TRADIER_REFRESH_TOKEN, TRADIER_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, TRADIER_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET. Do not pass TRADIER_IS_PAPER; BotSpot derives it from paperOrLive. Example credentialValues: {"TRADIER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER":"6AB12345","TRADIER_ACCESS_TOKEN":"token..."}. Charles Schwab (schwab): SCHWAB_ACCOUNT_NUMBER + SCHWAB_TOKEN. Example credentialValues: {"SCHWAB_ACCOUNT_NUMBER":"123456789","SCHWAB_TOKEN":"base64url-token-payload..."}. Tradovate (tradovate): TRADOVATE_USERNAME + TRADOVATE_DEDICATED_PASSWORD + TRADOVATE_CID + TRADOVATE_SECRET. Optional: TRADOVATE_APP_ID, TRADOVATE_APP_VERSION. Do not pass TRADOVATE_IS_PAPER; BotSpot derives it from paperOrLive. Example credentialValues: {"TRADOVATE_USERNAME":"username...","TRADOVATE_DEDICATED_PASSWORD":"dedicated-password...","TRADOVATE_CID":"client-id...","TRADOVATE_SECRET":"secret..."}. TopstepX (projectx-topstepx): PROJECTX_TOPSTEPX_API_KEY + PROJECTX_TOPSTEPX_USERNAME. Optional: PROJECTX_TOPSTEPX_PREFERRED_ACCOUNT_NAME. Example credentialValues: {"PROJECTX_TOPSTEPX_API_KEY":"key...","PROJECTX_TOPSTEPX_USERNAME":"username..."}. WEEX (weex): WEEX_API_KEY + WEEX_API_SECRET + WEEX_API_PASSPHRASE. Example credentialValues: {"WEEX_API_KEY":"key...","WEEX_API_SECRET":"secret...","WEEX_API_PASSPHRASE":"passphrase..."}. Bitunix (bitunix): BITUNIX_API_KEY + BITUNIX_API_SECRET. Optional: BITUNIX_TRADING_MODE. Example credentialValues: {"BITUNIX_API_KEY":"key...","BITUNIX_API_SECRET":"secret..."}. Kraken (kraken): KRAKEN_API_KEY + KRAKEN_API_SECRET. Example credentialValues: {"KRAKEN_API_KEY":"key...","KRAKEN_API_SECRET":"secret..."}. Coinbase (coinbase): COINBASE_API_KEY_NAME + COINBASE_PRIVATE_KEY. Optional: COINBASE_API_PASSPHRASE, COINBASE_SANDBOX. Example credentialValues: {"COINBASE_API_KEY_NAME":"organizations/.../apiKeys/...","COINBASE_PRIVATE_KEY":"-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----..."}. Any other CCXT 4.5.64 exchange id (for example okx, binance, bybit, bitget, hyperliquid): use that id as the broker and the credentials it requires, named <EXCHANGE>_API_KEY, <EXCHANGE>_API_SECRET, <EXCHANGE>_API_PASSPHRASE, <EXCHANGE>_UID, <EXCHANGE>_PRIVATE_KEY or <EXCHANGE>_WALLET_ADDRESS. Do not pass <EXCHANGE>_SANDBOX; BotSpot derives it from paperOrLive. Do not put data-provider API keys, screener rows, CSV data, workbooks, JSON dumps, or BotSpot internal keys here; use saved_env_vars(action="create") for non-broker runtime secrets.
name: update_broker_credential
title: Update saved broker credential
